title: [Czeroth Tunnel, Threshold]
description: Deep, jagged claw marks scar the rock walls surrounding a steel-banded ironwood door, its surface equally marred.  Greenish black ichor mingles with faded maroon bloodstains along the pathway, both somewhat obscured by detritus, dust, and stones.  Rusted steel sconces, empty of torches, line the walls, several wrenched from their positions and left askew where the claw marks cross them.
